name: ha-mcp
description: Configure and automate Home Assistant with Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants.
one_liner: A connector that lets an AI assistant like Claude or ChatGPT directly read sensors and control devices in a smart home, so you can say 'turn off everything downstairs' instead of opening an app.
buyer: A smart-home installer or home automation integrator who wants to offer clients voice/chat-based control without writing custom automation scripts for every house.
business_use_cases: A smart-home integrator installs it for elderly or disabled clients so family members can check on and control the home through a simple chat interface.
A short-term rental host wires it into their Home Assistant setup so guests can text a chatbot to control lights, locks, and climate instead of learning an app.
A home automation consultant sells a 'set it up once, talk to it forever' package, replacing a pile of brittle custom automations with natural-language control.

money_ideas.idea: Installation and setup service for smart-home owners who already run Home Assistant
Monthly 'AI home concierge' subscription bundling setup, monitoring, and support

steal_this: Offer a flat-rate 'talk to your house' setup package to Home Assistant users in a local smart-home forum this week.
